text: こった　ニックネームも　いいが　おぼえやすいのが　いちばん　やな！

structure.jp: こった　ニックネームも

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands for 'the one that is...'. おぼえやすいの = 'the one that is easy to remember'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai-dialect form of だ, and な is a soft ending. いちばん　やな = 'it's the best, isn't it'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい after a verb stem means easy to do. おぼえやすい = 'easy to remember'.
